dimensions.summary: Scale behavior is governed by one manifest, one executable runner, immutable runtime ceilings and canonical documentation.
Small, normal, large-Node and browser-safe proxy classes plus maximum extension namespaces are deterministic and bounded.
Local percentile, observed-heap, soak, cold-load and bundle budgets pass; real-browser timing and true peak RSS profiling remain remote evidence.
Immutable hard ceilings, extreme-depth rejection, extension overflow and prototype-pollution controls fail closed.
The pure validator and scale corpus use synthetic portable data without filesystem, credential, telemetry or network access.
Browser/CSP bundling and Node proxy workloads pass locally; real browser plus Linux, macOS and Windows evidence is pending.
All runtime limits and cancellation remain browser-neutral with zero runtime dependencies and no CLI bridge.
Workloads are byte-deterministic; repeated, soak and worker-thread validations return identical valid outcomes.
A near-1MiB previous envelope migrates within budget and unknown extensions remain governed by existing compatibility semantics.
Cooperative pre-cancellation, diagnostic ceilings, 1,000-run soak and bounded worker timeout behavior are observable and fail closed.
Workload construction, live measurement, machine baseline, unit contracts and limitations are independently reviewable.
The real tarball ships the scale manifest and passes locally; remote provenance, audit and publication admission remain pending.

checks.evidence: 11 files and 85 tests passed with generation, type, lint, format, coverage, build, transitive bundle, live scale and installed-tarball gates.
All four workload classes, compatibility, extensions, cancellation, adversarial depth, soak, concurrency and cold-load budgets passed.
Shared 85 tests, Graph 12 tests, package quality, dependency boundaries, mirror policy, builds and installed tarballs passed.
17 central CLI boundary and publication-contract tests passed; no runtime bridge was introduced.
Linux, macOS, Windows, real-browser timing and platform peak-memory profiling are required before admission.

approval.rule: Bounded SH4 internal-consumer migration is approved. Pending remote scale evidence still cannot advance standalone admission or authorize publication.
